messages:
Maya: Heads-up — run of the new eval harness (concurrency sweep) showed cost/token jump at >256 clients. Not sure if harness or model.
Owen: Can you paste the run log? run id?
Maya: run id 2026-06-18_08:23 id=eval-17812
Maya: baseline (master) cost: 0.00042 USD/token at 128c, at 512c shows 0.00043. New harness branch shows 0.00086 at 512c.
Tess: that's 2x, yikes. Did you change batching or telemetry?
Maya: Only change was a telemetry refactor (sampler -> time_bucket) + a tiny runner dispatch change.
Owen: grabbing logs...
Owen: log snippet:
```
[runner] requests=512 concurrency=512
[telemetry] tokens=125000 duration_ms=312000
[telemetry] cost_cents=108
```
Owen: tokens/duration_ms is wrong — duration in ms but we treat as seconds in calc.
Samir: ohhhhh :grimacing: that's the classic unit mismatch
Maya: so that would halve throughput estimate => double cost/token
Owen: exact: we were dividing tokens by duration_ms rather than duration_s in the p95 pipeline.
Owen: fix ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3124
Tess: can you add a unit test that reproduces the calculation? put it in perf-utils tests
Owen: yeh, adding test. Command I used to reproduce locally:
```
pytest tests/perf/test_telemetry.py::test_duration_units -q
```
InfraBot: CI job perf-metrics -> failed (timeout) — rerun scheduled
Maya: also dashboard numbers show same inflated cost for last 5 deploys, need backfill
Samir: I can write a small migration to correct derived metrics in ClickHouse, but need approval for backfill window
Jia: what's the window? can we limit to last 3 days?
Maya: sounds ok, started on sandbox verify
Tess: also let's gate the eval harness in CI — small synthetic concurrency sweep with mocked timers
Owen: adding to CI: .github/workflows/perf-check.yml + test that asserts cost/token within 5% of baseline
Samir: will update dashboards and alerting thresholds, and add note to runbook
Maya: filed bug: INF-7893
Maya: thanks all, rolling patch to canary
InfraBot: deploy to canary succeeded — logs: https://ci.redwood/exec/1781234 :tada:
Tess: nice. follow-up: add comment in API docs about telemetry units
Owen: done in PR description
Maya: closing loop in 24h if no regressions :thumbsup:
